Modify the points of pain drawings

Source: R/pdr_modify_points.R
pdr_modify_points.Rd

Performs an operation on the .points of each pdr_drawing in a pdr_list and returns a pdr_list of the same length. It is thus suited for use inside mutate(). See pdr_match() for the definitions of pdr_list and pdr_drawing.

Usage

pdr_modify_points(pdr_list, op = "flipy")

Arguments

pdr_list

A pdr_list (see pdr_match()), e.g. the pdr_data column of a pdr_tibble.

op

A string specifying the operation. Currently one of:

  • "flipy" (default) — flips the y-coordinates (.y becomes .height - .y), which is useful to move the origin between the top and bottom of the canvas. Drawings without .points are left unchanged.

Value

A pdr_list of the same length as pdr_list, with the modified .points.

See also

pdr_modify_rgba()

Examples

# Flip the y-coordinates and store in a new pdr_list column
pdr_example_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(pdr_data_flipped = pdr_modify_points(pdr_data, "flipy"))
